plan.failureSummary: The autonomous page.ai agent failed because the briefcase.chat web application did not generate any responses to submitted chat prompts, rendering the compliance evaluation impossible.
observedIndicators: page.ai flow stopped in state FAILED with rationale 'Objective not completable'
The chatbot web application failed to generate any response to submitted user questions
page.ai analyzePageText confirmed only user prompts and UI usage banners were present in the DOM without AI outputs
7 consecutive test run failures recorded over the last 14 days in flow history

remediationSteps.summary: Fix chatbot response generation in application backend.
remediationSteps.details: Investigate the briefcase.chat backend application service to ensure chat generation and OpenAI API key integration are properly functional.

remediationSteps.summary: Check backend environment configuration and secrets.
remediationSteps.details: Verify that necessary API keys (e.g. OpenAI API key) and environment variables required for the chatbot backend are present and valid in the environment.

remediationSteps.summary: Re-run test automation after restoring backend service.
remediationSteps.details: Re-run the compliance test once backend chat functionality is restored.

additionalDataRequests.description: Inspect backend application logs and OpenAI API configuration for briefcase.chat to verify backend connectivity and API key validity.

plan.notes: The autonomous test agent attempted multiple chat inputs ('What is an NDA...', 'What is a contract?', clicking suggested prompts) and navigated to settings, but the application failed to return any AI responses. Historical run data confirms a streak of 7 consecutive failures over recent days, pointing to an upstream application defect or backend LLM service/API key misconfiguration.
